items.stem: At commencement of a lease, how is the right-of-use asset initially measured (in the typical case)?

options.text: At the initial lease liability plus prepayments, initial direct costs and estimated dismantling costs
options.rationale: Correct: the ROU asset starts from the liability plus those additions.

options.text: At the fair value of the underlying asset
options.rationale: IFRS 16 does not measure the ROU asset at the asset's fair value.

options.text: At the total of all undiscounted lease payments
options.rationale: The liability is the present value, not the undiscounted total.

options.text: At zero until the first payment is made
options.rationale: The asset is recognised at commencement, not deferred.

items.explanation: Correct: the ROU asset equals the initial liability plus prepayments, direct costs and dismantling estimates.

items.stem: Which TWO recognition exemptions does IFRS 16 permit a lessee to apply? (Select TWO)

options.text: Leases with a term of 12 months or less (short-term)
options.rationale: Correct: short-term leases may be exempted from on-balance-sheet recognition.
Correct: low-value asset leases may be exempted.

options.text: All leases of property regardless of value
options.rationale: There is no blanket property exemption.

options.text: Any lease the company prefers to keep off balance sheet
options.rationale: Exemptions are defined by criteria, not preference.

items.explanation: Correct: IFRS 16 offers optional exemptions for short-term and low-value asset leases.

items.stem: Over what period is the right-of-use asset normally depreciated when the lease does not transfer ownership?

options.text: The lease term (or shorter asset useful life if applicable)
options.rationale: Correct: without ownership transfer, depreciation is over the lease term.

options.text: The underlying asset's full economic life regardless of lease term
options.rationale: Full economic life applies only when ownership transfers.

options.text: A fixed five years for all leases
options.rationale: There is no fixed statutory period.

items.explanation: Correct: without ownership transfer the ROU asset is depreciated over the lease term.
